messages:
Evan: logging a visual oddity on the metrics dashboard: axis tick labels auto-abbrev to K/M but the tooltip still shows full numbers, feels inconsistent when you hover. screenshot: https://redwood.example/snap/axis-abbrev-mismatch.png
Priya: good catch. we should keep tooltip canonical (full value) but the axis needs an affordance so people know it
bbrev. maybe add a tiny hint: "abbrev: K/M" after the axis label?
Sanjay: thought: let users choose scale mode per-panel: Compact (1.2K), Full (1,200), Adaptive (switches units by range). default to Adaptive. store preference in panel config.
Maya: accessibility note: screen readers should always read the full numeric value regardless of visual abbrev. aria-label on ticks should include the expanded value.
a11y-bot: Recommend aria-label pattern: "tick: 1,200 (one thousand two hundred)" and ensure locale-aware formatting.
Evan: also seeing odd behavior with long unit strings in axis title (e.g., "p95 latency (client, internal) ms"). it wraps and pushes tick labels. proposal: move unit to a dedicated inline pill at the axis title's end, with hover tooltip that shows context.
Priya: unit-pill sounds neat. visual: muted bg, 10px padding, 12px font, border-radius 6px. include full text in tooltip. aria-describedby to connect pill to axis for SR.
Sanjay: on smoothing: when smoothing is enabled we currently apply it client-side at render, which changes peaks but not the underlying numbers in the legend. that's confusing. two options: 1) legend shows smoothed values when smoothing on, 2) legend shows raw + smoothed in parenthesis. leaning to option 2 for transparency.
Maya: option 2 is better for audits. microcopy: legend value example -> "120ms (smoothed: 98ms)". also ensure color contrast for the smoothed value is adequate and not just low-contrast helper text.
a11y-bot: For the parenthetical smoothed value, ensure it
ppears in SR output as well: e.g., aria-label="p95 latency: 120 milliseconds; smoothed: 98 milliseconds".
Evan: spike markers are still drawing attention: can we implement an attenuation rule? e.g., if a series is spiky but ephemeral, render marker with 60% opacity and 6px radius instead of 10px. add a legend indicator that spikes are attenuated: small icon + "attenuated" label.
Priya: agree. UX question: should attenuation be per-series (user toggle) or global dashboard toggle? my vote: both - global default + per-series override in legend menu.
Sanjay: server can compute spike-sensitivity and provide spikeSeverity in payload (low/med/high). client maps that + user attenuation level -> final marker style.
Maya: keyboard shortcuts: propose "T" to toggle axis unit mode (Compact/Full/Adaptive) when the panel is focused. ensure discoverability in panel menu.
Evan: action items: Sanjay -> add spikeSeverity + denormalized fullNumericTick to API; Priya -> mock unit-pill and legend smoothed-value states; Maya -> update accessibility spec with SR patterns and keyboard flows. Sync Thursday 11am.
Priya: thanks! leaving a tiny prototype: https://redwood.example/design/axis-pill-proto.png
